The '''''Wandering Diva''''', or simply the '''''Diva''''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] known as [[Ley Neetels]] at least three [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], the vessel was used by Neetels to traverse [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. While flying the ''Wandering Diva'', the Jedi relied on the guidance of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to safely navigate the region's [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]], eventually reaching the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="FaD" />
